## Checks

- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has an entry under `[Unreleased]`, in plain words.
- [ ] A fix for a wrong answer has a test that fails on the commit before it.
- [ ] A new or changed command has an `examples/` model, and its numbers come from a calculation made outside Forge (by hand, a spreadsheet, R, Python), asserted in a test. Say how they were calculated:
- [ ] Docs this changes are updated, or carry a dated note if they describe a design that no longer exists.
- [ ] Numbers in this description were measured, not estimated.
